## Author Checklist
- [ ] Related feature issue linked (if one exists).
- [ ] New user-facing strings are translatable (tr()/QObject::tr() etc.).
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, Doxygen) if the feature is user-visible.
- [ ] No new compiler warnings introduced.
- [ ] Verified on both Linux and Windows (or explained why not).
